heading: Moogdayo’s face reveal goes viral with 20 million views as CDawgVA defends VTuber from online mockery
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 14:51 IST
paragraphs: VTuber Moogdayo, also known as Moog, is receiving huge attention online after revealing her real face on X
Her post has reached nearly 20 million views, bringing both kind messages and cruel jokes from internet users
The reveal came shortly after she appeared during a broadcast featuring popular creators CDawgVA and Ironmouse at VExpo in the UK
As some people began making fun of her appearance, CDawgVA spoke out in her defense

His response has added another important part to Moog’s viral face reveal story.Moogdayo’s face reveal reaches nearly 20 million views after VExpo appearanceMoogdayo shared her face reveal on X on September 19

The post quickly gained attention and has now crossed 20 million views, bringing her name to a much wider audience.Before the reveal, Moog had appeared during an IRL broadcast with Connor “CDawgVA” Colquhoun and Ironmouse at VExpo in the United Kingdom.A 28-second clip from the event was shared on X
It showed Moog approaching the two creators, introducing herself, and asking for a photo
During the meeting, CDawgVA also noticed a cardboard cutout featuring Moog’s virtual avatar.Moog is known as an “ice cream alien VTuber.” She creates content as both a streamer and artist
Instead of showing her real face during regular streams, she uses a virtual character.She also enjoys horror games
According to the information shared about her channel, she has streamed more than 188 hours of Dead by Daylight
Her channel has around 1,500 followers, with an average of 16 viewers per stream.Her face reveal has now introduced her to people who may not have known her work before

However, the attention has not been positive for everyone.CDawgVA defends Moogdayo after online mockeryAfter Moogdayo’s face reveal spread across X, some users posted jokes and negative comments about her appearance
Other people supported the VTuber and criticized those who were making fun of her.CDawgVA later spoke about the situation and defended Moog

He criticized people who attack creators because of how they look.Connor described X as “the hellscape of an app” and said the amount of hatred he sees there can feel “suffocating.” He also compared online behavior with real life, saying people are often kind and happy when they meet in person.His comments showed his frustration with the way some internet users treat creators
He called the situation “depressing” and encouraged Moogdayo to continue sharing herself online.For VTubers, face reveals can be major moments
Many creators build their careers while keeping their real identities private
When they decide to show their faces, the reaction can be difficult to predict.Moogdayo’s face reveal has become a major online talking point after reaching nearly 20 million views on X
While many people have shown support, others have mocked her appearance
CDawgVA has spoken against the negativity and encouraged Moog to keep being herself
The incident highlights how quickly a creator’s personal moment can spread online and why kindness matters when people step into the public eye.Catch the latest World News and Live updates
